editorialSummary.heading: What Irving ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: Winter no-school stretch runs through January 5
High schools use A, B, and C instructional days
paragraphs: Irving ISD students start Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and the last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 9-12, followed by a teacher workday/student holiday on October 13. Students are also off November 2-3, and Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27.

December 17-18 are early-dismissal days before Christmas Break begins December 21. Christmas Break ends January 1, but January 4-5 are teacher workdays/student holidays, so students return Wednesday, January 6. February 12 and Presidents Day on February 15 create a four-day weekend. Spring Break is March 15-19, Good Friday is March 26, and the final two student days, May 26-27, use the early-dismissal schedule.

High school families also have a separate Irving ISD A/B/C Day calendar. The first day of school is a C Day, and the separate A/B/C Day calendar shows the rotation when high school students return after major breaks. Early-dismissal times vary by school level; half-day PreK3 is not included in the published early-dismissal schedule.

comparativeInsights: Fall Break and the October 13 teacher workday form a continuous October 9-13 no-school stretch; students return October 14.
The November 2 holiday and November 3 teacher workday create two consecutive student holidays before classes resume November 4.
Christmas Break connects across the weekend to January 4-5 student holidays, so students are away from school continuously from December 21 through January 5.
The February 12 student holiday and Presidents Day on February 15 connect across the weekend for four consecutive days without classes.
The high school A/B/C calendar follows the same first day, holidays, breaks, and last day as the student calendar.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Irving ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. It begins the first grading period, and the high school A/B/C calendar marks it as a C Day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Irving ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The final student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. It is an early-dismissal day, the end of the sixth grading period, and a B Day on the high school calendar.

faqs.question: When is Irving ISD Fall Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break is October 9-12, 2026. October 13 is a teacher workday/student holiday, so students return Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: Are Irving ISD students off November 2-3, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. November 2 is a holiday, and November 3 is a teacher workday/student holiday. Classes resume Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: When is Irving ISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Irving ISD winter break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Irving ISD’s official calendar calls it Christmas Break. It runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027.

faqs.question: When do Irving ISD students return after Christmas Break?
faqs.answer: January 4-5 are teacher workdays/student holidays, so students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

faqs.question: Does Irving ISD have a four-day weekend in February 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Friday, February 12, for a teacher workday/student holiday and Monday, February 15, for Presidents Day. They return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: When is Irving ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 15-19, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is Irving ISD closed on Good Friday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Good Friday, March 26, 2027, is a holiday with no classes.

faqs.question: When are Irving ISD early-dismissal days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Early dismissal is scheduled for December 17-18, 2026, and May 26-27, 2027. All four dates remain student attendance days.

faqs.question: What time do Irving ISD students leave on early-dismissal days?
faqs.answer: Early childhood schools dismiss at 12:30 p.m. except half-day PreK3; elementary at 12:15 p.m.; middle school at 12:45 p.m.; Cardwell at 1 p.m.; and Singley, Irving, MacArthur, and Nimitz at 1:15 p.m.

faqs.question: What are the regular Irving ISD school hours?
faqs.answer: Half-day PreK3 morning sessions run 7:45-10:45 a.m. and afternoon sessions run 12:15-3:15 p.m. Elementary and full-day PreK run 7:45 a.m.-3:15 p.m.; middle school runs 8:15 a.m.-3:45 p.m.; high school and Singley run 8:45 a.m.-4:15 p.m.; and Cardwell runs 8:30 a.m.-4 p.m.

faqs.question: When do Irving ISD grading periods end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Grading periods end September 18, October 30, and December 18, 2026, then February 19, April 9, and May 27, 2027.

faqs.question: Who uses the Irving ISD A/B/C Day calendar?
faqs.answer: The separate A/B/C Day calendar is for high school students following that rotation. Elementary and middle school families should use the regular student calendar and any campus-specific schedule.

faqs.question: What is an A Day, B Day and C Day in Irving ISD?
faqs.answer: A Days cover periods 1-4, B Days cover periods 5-8, and C Days include all eight periods in the order 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8.

faqs.question: What A/B/C Day do Irving ISD high school students return on after each major break?
faqs.answer: High school students return on an A Day October 14, November 4, November 30, January 6, March 22 and March 29. The February 16 return is a B Day.

faqs.question: Is the first day of school a C Day for Irving ISD high schools?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 2026-2027 high school A/B/C Day calendar marks Tuesday, August 11, 2026 as a C Day, when students attend all eight periods.

faqs.question: Do Irving ISD high schools follow the same holidays and breaks as the regular student calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Irving ISD high schools use the same holidays, breaks, first day, and last day as the regular student calendar. The separate A/B/C calendar shows which class periods meet on each high school attendance day.

faqs.question: How does Irving ISD announce weather closures or delays?
faqs.answer: Irving ISD says it will notify parents and staff through School Messenger phone calls, social media, the district website, and local media stations.

faqs.question: Where can families check for Irving ISD calendar revisions?
faqs.answer: Use the official Irving ISD calendar page for the current Student Calendar and A/B/C Day Calendar downloads. Campus messages remain the best source for school-specific changes.
